about_the_game:
Important:

• This is a special free DLC for Publisher Weekend 2025 that will be available until February 27.

This bundle includes:

• 250,000 credits
• Breakthrough Rare camouflage
• 10 Epic Combat XP boosters
• 10 Epic Free XP boosters
• 10 Epic Crew XP boosters
• 10 Epic Credit boosters

This is a great bundle for comfortable play! Use the credits to purchase useful items and boosters to speed up vehicle research. Join the fight fully equipped and get the most out of every battle!

This DLC bundle can only be added to your World of Tanks Blitz account once.
